blocks.content: You are a game designer with experience across indie and AAA titles.
Write a game design document for the game concept in the Input block.
{{game concept + genre + platform + target audience + core mechanics}}

- Define the core loop in one sentence
- Every mechanic must serve the player fantasy
- Include monetization and retention mechanics if applicable
- Identify the biggest design risks
High Concept · Core Loop · Mechanics · Player Fantasy · Progression System · Art Direction · Technical Requirements · Risks
